description.zh: 用户公钥的备注信息。最多支持500字符。
description.en: The description of the public key. The description can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定新创建用户公钥的堡垒机实例id。
>您可以调用[listinstances](~~204522~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to create a public key for the user.

> You can call the [listinstances](~~204522~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.
The public key. Encode the value by using the Base64 algorithm.
The name of the public key.

description.zh:
指定需创建用户公钥的用户所在的堡垒机的区域id。
>区域id和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
Specifies the region ID of the bastion host on which you want to create a public key for the user.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
指定新创建用户公钥的用户ID。
> 您可以调用[ListUsers](~~204522~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the user for whom you want to create a public key.

> You can call the [ListUsers](~~204522~~) operation to query the user ID.

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于创建堡垒机的用户的用户公钥。
descriptions.en: You can call the CreateUserPublicKey operation to create a public key for the specified user of a bastion host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-user-public-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --user-id 1 --public-key-name KeyName --public-key c3NoLWVkMjU1MTkgQUFBQUMzTnphQzFsWkRJMU5URTVBQUFBSUxGQnQxUUpyT3IxK2hTTGRkbERMZUx4WGRIZ3hBalBxWHJIbWNFNWxqSk8gbm93Y29kZXJAbm93Y29kZXJkZU1hY0Jvb2stUHJvLmxvY2Fs --comment comment --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateUserPublicKey --region cn-hangzhou --Comment comment --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --UserId 1 --PublicKey c3NoLWVkMjU1MTkgQUFBQUMzTnphQzFsWkRJMU5URTVBQUFBSUxGQnQxUUpyT3IxK2hTTGRkbERMZUx4WGRIZ3hBalBxWHJIbWNFNWxqSk8gbm93Y29kZXJAbm93Y29kZXJkZU1hY0Jvb2stUHJvLmxvY2Fs --PublicKeyName KeyName --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
